description: Query and exercise constitutional agent rights (Colony Phase 3). Actions: query_rights (view rights for a charter), explain_rejection (get structured explanation for a gate rejection). Rights enforcement runs automatically in the dispatch pipeline — this tool provides visibility and manual exercise.

action.description: Action to perform: query_rights = view constitutional rights for a charter; explain_rejection = get structured explanation for a rejected gate

charter_id.description: Charter ID to query rights for (required for query_rights)

gate_id.description: Gate ID to explain (required for explain_rejection)

institution_id.description: Institution ID that owns the charter (required for query_rights — pass the institution_id from board_list_institutions or board_list_charters)

name: agent_rights
